description: This file is a shell script responsible for managing LED indicators during different system states such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, and done. It defines functions to find specific LED devices and to set their states accordingly.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the basename of the power LED device for the system.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the basename of the fault LED device for the system.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided system status argument (preinit, failsafe, preinit_regular, upgrade, done).
